fusions.name: Tangling Reach
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second. Each hit has a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Squeeze
fusions.desc: Wraps the target for 8 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Arm Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Squidling Guard
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of water that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. It also slows what it hits by 15% for 2 seconds.
